scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.dev: node init && node scripts/patch-electron-mac-identity.mjs && electron-vite dev
scripts.dev:cosmic: node init && node scripts/patch-electron-mac-identity.mjs && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: node init && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.build:unpack: node init && npm run build && electron-builder --dir -c.electronDist=node_modules/.pnpm/electron@44.9.1_supports-color@7.2.0/node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.build:win: node init && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: node init && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac && node scripts/codesign-mac-app.mjs
scripts.build:mac:intel: node init && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --x64 && node scripts/codesign-mac-app.mjs
scripts.build:mac:arm: node init && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 && node scripts/codesign-mac-app.mjs
scripts.build:linux:ubuntu: node init && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
